dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Linear narrowing of the dorsal mass from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus, forming a sharp point in the lower field of view.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Subtle convex bulge on the mid-left lateral margin; right margin remains relatively linear before the posterior taper begins.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse longitudinal greyish streaks running parallel to the central axis, most visible in the posterior half.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the primary white surface and the localized grey longitudinal clusters.
